# malloc_buf 0.0.6 — notice disclosure

Declared license: **MIT**. Dependency role: transitive dependency through the
optional `metal` feature (`mageckrs` → `metal` → `objc` → `malloc_buf`).

The exact locked archive did not include complete release-specific notice text.
Available upstream evidence was reviewed, including the [0.0.6 source release](https://github.com/SSheldon/malloc_buf/tree/a7811e5f4c6f9685dd57ad9bfe34e9bf6b0ba4f9)
and its [MIT manifest declaration](https://github.com/SSheldon/malloc_buf/blob/a7811e5f4c6f9685dd57ad9bfe34e9bf6b0ba4f9/Cargo.toml).
A [later upstream MIT notice](https://github.com/SSheldon/malloc_buf/blob/d9a3e539642bd90e07df458d226b19cdfa606863/LICENSE)
was [accepted upstream](https://github.com/SSheldon/malloc_buf/pull/3), but is not
treated as proof that it applied to version 0.0.6. Its text and attribution are not
backported here as the definitive notice for this historical release.

MAGeCKrs accepts publication with this historical notice-evidence gap disclosed.
No redistribution prohibition was identified in the reviewed evidence. This does
not supply missing historical attribution, relicense the package, constitute
legal advice, or claim external legal clearance.
